description: EveryInfra's OpenAI-compatible text completions with multi-turn history and any input content or format. Free for accounts that have topped up (nothing is deducted); accounts that have not get ai_topup_required. Rate-limited per account by cumulative top-ups (under $100: 50 requests/minute, $100 or more: 500, $500 or more: 5,000, all keys combined); current models: GET /api/v1/models. Good for cleaning collected data: summaries, translation, sentiment labels, topic classification and structured extraction. messages may total up to 45,000 characters; beyond that you get input_too_large — split long documents into several calls.

messages.description: OpenAI-format conversation, e.g. [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}] (role is system / user / assistant).

model.description: Optional, default gemini-3.6-flash. Allowed: gemini-3.6-flash / gemini-flash-lite

name: everyinfra_chat
title: Generate or analyze text
